We are ORBIT OPERATORS — a team of ambitious college students driven by curiosity, innovation, and a shared passion.

Team Line-up

Kavach Shastri (KS) — Mission Lead

Guides the project, sets priorities, and keeps the team on schedule.

Adhyatm Shastri (AS) — Radar Analyst

Interprets NISAR radar signals, bands, and interferograms.

Harsh Sahu (HS) — Data Explorer

Finds, prepares, and checks the data used for each scene.

Harsh Vishwkarma (HV) — System Visual Designer

Designs the visuals.
